project_context.archetype: The Old Money Tech & Swiss High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth)

rules.headings: tracking-tight, never center-aligned by default. Use font-light for elegance or font-bold for impact, avoiding generic 'regular'.
rules.body: leading-relaxed, highly readable. Use IBM Plex Sans to give a technical, precise public-service feel.
rules.overline_labels: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm for section tags (e.g., 'FEATURED PROJECTS').

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900

rules.contrast: Ensure pure Royal Blue background has pure white text. Gold accent should be used sparingly for trust badges, primary CTAs, or active states.
rules.backgrounds: Use solid cool-tinted grays (slate-50) for alternate sections to break up pure white, not generic Vercel-like dotted backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky nav: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50 shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton for feature grids using border-collapse style (Grid Borders). Use 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200) for cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]) for marketing cards. Dashboard should be mostly flat with 1px borders.

marketing_pages.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Container internal padding must be p-6 or p-8 minimum.
marketing_pages.structure: Asymmetrical layouts for Home & Projects to avoid typical Bootstrap corporate templates. Mix 2-col and 3-col grids with varying row spans.

admin_dashboard.structure: Grid layouts for CRM stats. Every pixel utilized. Rectangular, dense styles. Avoid overuse of the generic Shadcn Card if it feels too fluffy.

components_customization.buttons: Sharp or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Primary CTAs should be Royal Blue with hover state bg-[#002277] text-white. Secondary CTAs outline with slate.
components_customization.forms: High-contrast inputs. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0033A0] focus:border-transparent. No default HTML inputs.
components_customization.navigation: Crystal glassmorphism sticky header. Logo left, links center, CTA right. Links MUST be visible on desktop (no hamburger).
components_customization.tables: Shadcn Table for Admin Dashboard. Striped rows or clean 1px borders. Add status badges with subtle tint backgrounds (e.g., bg-green-50 text-green-700).
components_customization.accordion: For FAQ on project pages. Minimal lines, plus/minus icons, Royal Blue active state.

motion.hover_states: translate-y-[-2px] transition-transform duration-200 ease-out. Always define hover text colors.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (framer-motion) for main section elements on scroll (staggered children).

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA minimums. Text on Gold background requires dark text (text-slate-900). Text on Royal Blue requires white.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY data-testid attributes on all buttons, forms, links, and inputs.

hero_and_corporate.description: Indian professionals working in a premium modern open office
Three people collaborating, representing leadership and trust

libraries_and_packages: @phosphor-icons/react (MANDATORY: install for premium corporate duotone/light icons)
framer-motion (for page transitions, staggering, and scroll effects)
sonner (for form submission and admin dashboard toasts)
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Outfit' font for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS imports.
Set up Tailwind config with the specified Royal Blue (#0033A0) and Gold (#C5A059) colors.
Build a clear, robust routing structure for all required pages (Home, About, Projects/APAAR, Projects/PAN2, Join, Careers, Contact, Admin Dashboard).
Hero section must use the provided modern office image with a dark/blue gradient overlay (e.g. bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0033A0]/90 to-transparent) to ensure text contrast while retaining premium feel.
Do NOT use standard rounded-xl cards everywhere. SKL is a serious enterprise. Use sharp edges or minimal rounded-sm to maintain authority.

Admin dashboard must be a distinct layout (sidebar + topbar) showing CRM tables (leads, agents, careers) with search/filter/export functionality. Make it look like a high-end enterprise internal tool, NOT a marketing page.
Every form (Contact, Agent Registration, Careers) must be robustly built with Shadcn form components, clear validation states, and sonner toasts on success.
Use data-testid attributes extensively as mandated.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make it look like Deloitte or Infosys built it for $500k.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, not just flat dropshadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navigational elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Only use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Do not rewrite Shadcn components from scratch.
